title: Buy deadline across private escalation attempts

options.name: Keep current behaviour: one 60 s deadline for all attempts
options.risk: Attempts after 60 s are doomed to revert in simulation, so the private escalation is cut short (missed snipes).

options.name: Rebuild the tx with a fresh deadline per attempt
options.behavior_impact: Every attempt is valid when sent.
options.risk: Each attempt is a new signed tx; the reconcile logic must keep tracking every broadcast hash (see AUD-BUY-002 trace 2).

options.name: Size one deadline to the whole escalation budget
options.behavior_impact: One tx stays valid for every attempt.
options.risk: A long deadline lets a late inclusion buy at a stale price (minOut still applies).

recommendation: rebuild-per-attempt, together with the TX slice fix that reconciles every broadcast hash.
default: Keep current behaviour until the owning phase decides (milestone contract). The linked finding is S3.
behavior_impact: Decides how long a snipe stays valid while the bot escalates fees.
needed_by: Phase 24 discussion (with the TX slice submit changes) or Phase 29
